summary: Targeted re-test of FacebookFeed widget sizing/containment on Home. Logged in as kidsform@gmail.com/Password123, scrolled to 'LATEST FROM FACEBOOK' at phone (390px) and desktop (1280px) viewports. Both tabs, Open button, and iframe render correctly, fully contained within the viewport, no horizontal page overflow, iframe clamped to FB-supported width (180-500px) and centered on wide screens. Blank iframe content is expected (Facebook X-Frame-Options in headless).
critical_code_review_comments: FacebookFeed.tsx is clean and small (~140 lines). Uses onLayout to measure and clamps plugin width to FB's supported 180-500px. Iframe on web has maxWidth:100% and explicit width, preventing overflow.
Home 'LATEST FROM FACEBOOK' section title uses paddingHorizontal via sectionTitle style; FacebookFeed wrap adds its own paddingHorizontal — consistent with other sections.
Non-blocking: console warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' appears somewhere on Home (not from FacebookFeed) — reported for awareness.
seed_data_creation: None (existing test member kidsform@gmail.com was already registered).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Facebook widget fix validated. Measured metrics: PHONE(390) -> iframe w=356 x=17 right=373, no horizontal scroll (body=390=win). DESKTOP(1280) -> iframe w=500 (clamped), x=390 right=890 (centered within 1248px container), no horizontal scroll. Tabs (fb-tab-fitness, fb-tab-combat) toggle active state; Open button (fb-open-page) opens correct FB page URL. Iframe body appears blank due to FB X-Frame-Options blocking cross-frame render in headless — expected per problem statement.
rca_of_issue: Original bug: embedded FB feed overflowed / was cut off. Fix (onLayout width clamped to FB plugin's 180-500 range + centered feedCard container with maxWidth:100% on iframe) resolves horizontal overflow at all viewport widths and keeps content contained. Confirmed via Playwright measurements at 390 and 1280 widths.
